blocks.title: Worked example · Rollback both changes
blocks.text: Atomicity means the transfer is all-or-nothing. A DBMS transaction can roll back partial changes. Consistency checks valid constraints; isolation keeps concurrent transfers safe; durability preserves committed transfers.
